note_tweet.text:
It’s not “just” a Roman salute as his worshipers would have you believe. Elon Musk’s hand gesture looks a lot like a N*zi salute to us. And it is a chilling reminder of just who Musk is - a powerful right-wing oligarch who rose to power on a wave of disinformation and lies that he helps spread on his own platform. 

This man is the friend of the AfD, who has given this  German far-right party a loud, powerful platform in the run-up to elections.

The same man who is determined to abuse his social media toy to turn Europe far right. 

We won’t have that!
